decisions.summary: Build a local-first governed execution and telemetry layer for AI coding CLIs, not a generic gateway or full AgentOS.
Use one installer contract with OS-specific adapters; standalone is user-scoped, cluster is Linux-only, Windows is Git-Bash-first.
Use Paperclip-style primitives: roles, budgets, seed prompts, HITL gates, receipts, and worktrees. Do not build full AgentOS first.
Deterministic guided NL query over parquet is free/core; AI or local model NL-to-query is optional and guarded.
PWA/dashboard is free/core; Android/Web Push is optional and doctor-gated, with OIDC only for shared/team-scoped push.
